name: Electro Kick
notes:
electroKickSeed: a HARD ELECTRONIC / EDM kick (the deliberately-synthetic
counterpart to the organic dnb-kick). Punchy variant, a strong beater click +
sharp attack transient, real harmonics for edge, a fast tight pitch snap, and
drive — everything the organic kick avoids.
2026-10-02 FULLNESS RETUNE (user A/B at equal peak, approved): louder under the
fixed peak, more punch and body, same variant, pitch and >250 Hz timbre. Changed:
fade 14→8, h2 0.45→0.09, click 0.22→0.06, env0 9→6, attack 0.5→0, pe_amt
0.25→0.4, env1 16→10
(dropped) gen1_kick_h3: harmonic edge
(dropped) gen1_kick_noise: a click, not a clipping spike
